title: GraphRAG for Drone Design
summary: Connecting drone design knowledge across technical documents with graph-based retrieval.
overview: This ongoing research explores how GraphRAG can support drone design by connecting knowledge across technical documents. The aim is to organize and retrieve relevant engineering evidence, helping users interpret design requirements and make informed design decisions.

documents.title: RAG Fundamentals & Knowledge Graph Integration
documents.description: Embeddings, FAISS retrieval, RAG implementation, and initial knowledge graph integration experiments.
